title: Hatul's enchantments
description: A Minecraft mod that adds more enchantments to the game!
body:
# Made with mcreator

## What enchantments are added?

### Pathmaker
**On level 1** Pathmaker turns blocks you step on into path blocks, which can be used for building or marking ways quickly

**On level 2** Pathmaker works the same as in level 1, but it creates paths 3 blocks wide

**On level 3** Pathmaker also makes paths on stone, sand, red sand, andesite, diorite, graphite, and netherack

You can't get Pathmaker from the enchantment table

**Important warning!!**
Pathmaker isn't toggleable and takes more durability than usual off your boots. I suggest putting it on a spare pair of boots

### Blazefire
A flint and steel enchantment that turns it into a flamethrower!

available on an enchanting table, but with a book (doesn't work with flint and steel)

### Perfect parry
An enchantment that overhauls normal shield mechanics. Right-click exactly when you are being hurt (max 3 ticks before) to redirect half of the damage back to the attacker and stun them for 10 seconds while buffing you.

This enchantment won't appear at enchantment tables, and **attempting to block normally with it will break the shield**

# Known Bugs
- perfect parry is inconsistent in offhand
- if you time it right, you can hit yourself with your own fireball while running


That's it for now

More coming soon!
